requirements.basis: Absent native boundary preserves ordinary root context; known pending or cancelled boundary refuses ordinary fallback.
Protected host-generated IDs and exact signed delegation/seed references, permanent capability and principal indices.
Only retained EnforcedChild custody can authorize observation. Model/provider channels are disabled, never reused.
Selected roots and whole exact return descriptors bind child, parent, lineage, epoch, artifact, launch and current policy.
Native knowledge join and stable admission commit before sink I/O. Sink checks independently committed join at first byte.
All private stdout/stderr candidates are finite. Every other route is withheld and selected cage denies file/network/callback escape.
Canonical JSON and exact recomputation never replace independent narrowing or integrity authority.
Retained original boundary, observation, seals, evidence consumption and count survive every disposition and writer reopen.
Native permanent aggregate counts coexist with original process quotas; pidfd deadline cannot be renewed by retained custody or chunking.
Fresh parent label/influence and full input dependencies join before stdin, with host-fixed argv/environment/profile and disabled egress.
